learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: kivaconfections.com/products holds 121 Kiva-family cards over two Webflow pages; 56 are Lost Farm, 6 of them with the NY market code.
notes: Lost Farm is a Kiva brand with no site of its own (lostfarm.com is unrelated). Kiva's /products grid holds every Kiva brand and state: each card's a.kv-pcard has data-brand (lost-farm, camino, kiva, petra, terra) and data-type (gummies, chews, vape), and a nested list of .kv-mkt market codes (NY, CA, MA...). The skip rules keep data-brand lost-farm with an NY code. The same title exists per state under different slugs, so the url is the id.

Titles are '<dose per piece> <Fruit> x <Strain> Live Resin|Live Rosin Gummies|Chews', with typos ('Gumies') and double spaces elsewhere. The line is Live Resin or Live Rosin and the strain is the 'Fruit x Strain' pair, as NY stores write them ('Lost Farm 'Dragonfruit x Frose' Live Resin Gummies [10pk]').

The card gives the dose per piece only. The flavor page gives the pack: 'THC per serving 10mg THC per pack 100mg Available in: NY' (lf-tropical-lemonade-do-si-dos-ny), and NY stores sell them as 10pk / 100mg, so a 10mg NY gummy is 10pk 100mg. Any other dose or a CBN/CBG ratio falls through to unparsed on purpose.

The NY card and flavor page still say 'Citrus Spritz x Napa', but Kiva has renamed that flavor Strawberry Lemonade (the AZ card 'Strawberry Lemonade x Joel's Lemonade' is slug lf-citrus-spritz-az, the OH 'Strawberry Lemonade x Lemon Slushee' is lf-citrus-splash-...), and NY stores sell it only as Strawberry Lemonade x Napa (four spellings, nine listings). The entry takes the current name; the site's is kept in its match terms.

NY stores also sell Lost Farm flavors the site does not tag NY (Thorny Berry x OG Kush 10mg THC:10mg CBN, Tropical Lemonade x Ztrawberry Guava live rosin on 2026-10-05); they come from the stores' consensus.

skip.why: Lost Farm, not sold in NY
